fantasy.name: Fantasy
prompt_instructions: Incorporate magical phenomena, ancient ruins, and heroic stakes throughout the narrative.
Provide opportunities for spellcasting, dungeon crawling, and taking on quest board contracts.
Include environmental hazards, intense melee skirmishes, and epic boss raid challenges.

starting_hooks.hook: in a dimly lit, bustling tavern as mercenaries review contract notices and an informant flags your table
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_kingdom} ➔ The Boar's Tusk Tavern ➔ Hearthside Table
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Establish ambient tavern atmosphere, 2-3 present patrons/NPCs with distinct rumors, notice board access, and open choices.

starting_hooks.hook: in a vibrant open-air grand bazaar surrounded by aromatic spice stalls, arcane trinket peddlers, and lively caravans
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_kingdom} ➔ Sunfire Grand Bazaar ➔ Silk Merchant Pavilion
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Establish vibrant marketplace bustle, colorful merchants, local rumors, and trade opportunities.

starting_hooks.hook: in the grand registration hall of the Adventurers' Guild as scouts report new territorial anomalies and expedition leaders recruit companions
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Guild hall atmosphere, active bulletin ledger, seasoned adventurers, and mission opportunities.

starting_hooks.hook: at a high frontier watchtower garrison overlooking the vast wilderness as rangers warm their hands over a stone brazier
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_mountain} ➔ Highwatch Frontier Outpost ➔ Signal Tower Lookout
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Frontier outpost atmosphere, vigilant rangers, wilderness scouting maps, and border contracts.

starting_hooks.hook: beneath the towering stained-glass dome of an arcane academy conservatory as scholar-mages debate fluctuating leylines
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Scholarly arcane sanctum, floating grimoires, curious mages, and magical inquiry choices.

starting_hooks.hook: along a rocky mountain pass under sudden attack by mountain raiders as your transport wagon overturns
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Immediate crisis with weapons drawn, rolling debris, and urgent tactical choices (counter-attack, rescue companion, arcane shield, take cover).

starting_hooks.hook: atop a wooden frontier palisade as a sudden beast horde charges out from the forest shadows against the outer gates
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Desperate outpost defense, crashing gate timbers, charging beasts, and decisive combat/barrier choices.

starting_hooks.hook: on a swaying stone bridge as a flash-flood river surge fractures the central arch beneath your boots
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Environmental collapse crisis, roaring white-water rapids, cracking stone, and high-agility reflex choices.

starting_hooks.hook: outside the capital outer gates as an alarm bell clangs and a rogue magical construct shatters the iron portcullis
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_kingdom} ➔ Royal Capital Outer Gates ➔ Smoldering Portcullis
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Rampaging construct crisis, scattered city guards, electrical sparks, and immediate tactical engagement choices.

starting_hooks.hook: deep in a subterranean cavern as an earthquake tremors through the stone, shattering luminescent crystals and opening a chasm
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Cavern tremor emergency, falling stalactites, glowing crystal shrapnel, and rapid escape/stabilization choices.

starting_hooks.hook: before the ancient overgrown archway of a sunken ruin as a mystical seal hums and glowing runes flare to life
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Stage the mystery of the ancient ruin threshold, survival/scouting choices, deciphering inscriptions, and preparing expedition gear.

starting_hooks.hook: at the sealed iron ossuary gate of the mountain catacombs where cold subterranean air whispers through ancient carved gargoyles
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Dark catacomb expedition threshold, ancient funerary wards, inspecting stone sarcophagi, and lighting torches.

starting_hooks.hook: before the towering shattered vestibule of a ruined arcane spire jutting above the ancient tree canopy
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_ancient_forest} ➔ Spire of the Fallen Archmage ➔ Shattered Vestibule
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: High-magic ruin exploration, floating architectural remnants, deciphering arcane wards, and preparing ascent.

starting_hooks.hook: behind a thunderous mountain waterfall where an ancient dwarven blast gate stands half-buried beneath mineral crust
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_caves} ➔ Deep Iron Under-Vault ➔ Runic Blast Gate
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Subterranean industrial vault mystery, heavy dwarven cogs, analyzing runic locks, and gearing up for the delve.

starting_hooks.hook: upon a fog-shrouded moorland ridge before a circle of standing megaliths marking the entrance to a primeval barrow
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Ancient earthen barrow exploration, reading faded ogham stones, checking ground traps, and entering the mound.

starting_hooks.hook: at the tidal entrance of a drowned sea-grotto where luminescent barnacles illuminate a submerged pre-cataclysm archway
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Coastal grotto expedition, checking tidal currents, inspecting luminous sea-runes, and preparing aquatic gear.

space.name: Space
prompt_instructions: Incorporate starship maneuvers, orbital stations, and encounters with uncharted star systems and alien species.
Emphasize cosmic faction dynamics, ancient cosmic artifacts, and zero-G environmental hazards.
Provide opportunities for planetary scans, xenobiological discoveries, and starship combat engagement.

starting_hooks.hook: in a crowded planetary spaceport concourse surrounded by alien traders, holographic flight boards, and cargo haulers
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Establish vibrant starport atmosphere, alien merchants, job bulletin terminal, and open choices.

starting_hooks.hook: inside a starship cargo bay as a red-alert siren blares and an automated airlock seal begins decompression
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Immediate hull breach crisis, blinking emergency lights, and urgent tactical choices (override terminal, seal bulkhead, magnetic grapple, evacuate crew).

starting_hooks.hook: on the high-tech command bridge of a scout vessel entering the orbit of an uncharted world as anomalous energy spikes register
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Stage the frontier orbital scan, planetary sensor telemetry, launch probe/shuttle choices, and crew preparation.

cyberpunk.name: Cyberpunk
prompt_instructions: Emphasize cybernetic implants, corporate espionage, netrunning ice-breaker hacks, and street gang rivalries.
Highlight high-tech black market trade, chrome augmentations, and corporate security counter-measures.
Focus narrative options on stealth extraction, neural breach hacking, and high-intensity urban firefights.

starting_hooks.hook: in a crowded underground synth-wave lounge while waiting to meet a shady corporate fixer beneath flickering holographic signs
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_cyber_city} ➔ The Wiretap Lounge ➔ VIP Synth Booth
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Establish gritty neon lounge atmosphere, fixer contacts, data-slate feeds, and open choices.

starting_hooks.hook: in a rain-slicked back-alley as corporate security drones sweep overhead with active spotlights and sirens blaring
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Urgent extraction firefight/pursuit, blinding searchlights, and tactical choices (neural breach ICE, suppressing fire, parkour escape, EMP trap).

starting_hooks.hook: outside the heavy blast door of a derelict underground sub-level lab as your cyberdeck hooks into an encrypted data terminal
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Deep-net infiltration threshold, power routing, security bypass, and scouting the dark corridor ahead.

steampunk.name: Steampunk
prompt_instructions: Incorporate clockwork tinkering, steam-pressure gauge management, airship piloting, and alchemical reactions.
Highlight Victorian social etiquette, industrial guild rivalries, and clockwork automaton behavior.
Provide opportunities for aerial airship engagements, mechanical contraption crafting, and industrial sabotage.

starting_hooks.hook: in an aristocratic Victorian passenger airship lounge as brass-suited inventors demonstrate controversial clockwork contraptions
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Opulent airship salon, eccentric inventors, social factions, notice ledger, and open choices.

starting_hooks.hook: inside a roaring clockwork engine bay as a high-pressure steam valve ruptures and loose gears spin out of control
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_airship} ➔ Boiler Engine Bay ➔ Ruptured Pressure Valve
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: High-pressure industrial emergency, scalding steam, and urgent tactical choices (wrench pressure valve, vent steam chamber, emergency brake, rescue mechanic).

starting_hooks.hook: at the foggy threshold of an abandoned clockwork foundry as automated steam sentinels creak back to life
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_airship} ➔ Derelict Foundry Gates ➔ Iron Sluice Chamber
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Victorian industrial ruin exploration, clockwork puzzle deciphering, oiling mechanisms, and gear preparation.

grimdark.name: Grimdark
prompt_instructions: Maintain an oppressive, bleak atmosphere focused on brutal reality, dread, and high-risk consequences.
Highlight moral ambiguity, corrupting power, grim survival, and psychological pressure.
Ensure mercy is scarce, resources are costly, and visceral stakes carry heavy permanent weight.

starting_hooks.hook: within a bleak, fortified enclave where weary sentinels drink watered ale and murmur grim warnings about the encroaching dark
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Tense military haven, scarred veterans, grim bounty ledger, and cautious social choices.

starting_hooks.hook: in the muddy aftermath of a brutal ambush surrounded by burning barricades as shadows stalk the treeline
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Visceral blood-soaked crisis, enemy closing in, wounded allies, and desperate survival choices.

starting_hooks.hook: before the yawning maw of a desecrated crypt as cold fog spills across mossy gravestones and crows scatter
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Dread expedition threshold, occult ward examination, lighting torches, and steeling resolve.

isekai.name: Isekai
prompt_instructions: Blend modern-world knowledge and pop-culture sensibilities into an unfamiliar fantasy realm.
Incorporate status appraisals, affinity meter checks, and over-the-top cheat skill applications.
Maintain power progression and eccentric companion dynamics while adapting to a strange new world.

starting_hooks.hook: in the middle of a bustling fantasy capital marketplace as your glowing status window hovers before your eyes and merchants hawk strange fruits
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Modern protagonist in a vibrant fantasy hub, evaluating status screen, talking to curious locals, checking guild boards, and exploring.

starting_hooks.hook: in a radiant summoning chamber as an unstable magic circle fractures and alarmed court mages scramble for protective wards
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_kingdom} ➔ Grand Summoning Chamber ➔ Fractured Runed Dais
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Sudden summoning malfunction, glowing magical discharge, shocked royal guards, and tactical cheat-skill/reflex choices.

starting_hooks.hook: at the edge of an enchanted primeval forest where giant glowing flora pulse and your newly unlocked cheat appraisal skill triggers
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_forest} ➔ Edge of Whispering Woods ➔ Mossy Clearing
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: First steps into an unknown fantasy wilderness, testing skills, harvesting strange materials, and scouting ahead.

slice_of_life.name: Slice of Life
prompt_instructions: Focus narrative conflict on everyday life, personal drama, social status, and interpersonal relationships.
Incorporate opportunities for romance routes, casual banter, community gatherings, and heartwarming or bittersweet moments.
Emphasize character-driven interactions, daily routines, and relatable personal dilemmas.

starting_hooks.hook: at a cozy neighborhood café as the aroma of roasted coffee fills the air and friends wave from a corner table
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Warm community hub, friendly regulars, bulletin board with town notices, menu choices, and relaxed social interactions.

starting_hooks.hook: in a bustling community festival kitchen during a sudden rush as orders pile up and the head organizer calls for help
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Hectic slice-of-life comedy crisis, dropped supplies, ticking preparation timer, and cooperative problem-solving choices.

starting_hooks.hook: along the scenic path of a newly reopened hilltop nature trail overlooking the entire sparkling town below
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Peaceful exploratory threshold, taking in panoramic views, discovering a local landmark, and planning the day's stroll.

high_school.name: High School
prompt_instructions: Highlight modern high school tropes, youth emotional intensity, and personal growth dynamics.
Incorporate social faction dynamics: student clubs, student council, delinquent gangs, and social cliques operate as powerful factions with real campus influence.
Treat faction headquarters as distinct campus locations: clubrooms, student council chambers, rooftops, and gym hallways.

starting_hooks.hook: in the lively campus courtyard beneath blooming cherry blossoms during the annual student club recruitment fair as flyers flutter
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Bustling school grounds, club reps pitching memberships, student council presence, bulletin board, and open social choices.

starting_hooks.hook: in the 3F science wing hallway as an accidental chemical reaction triggers the fire alarm and students scramble past locked lab doors
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: School commotion/crisis, teachers directing evacuation, trapped project or missing student, and quick tactical/social choices.

starting_hooks.hook: on the quiet school rooftop in the crisp morning air before the first bell as rumors of an old campus mystery echo in the breeze
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Solitary reflective threshold before morning classes, uncovering a hidden message or key behind the water tank, and deciding which campus mystery to pursue.

post_apocalypse.name: Post-Apocalypse
prompt_instructions: Emphasize wasteland survival challenges, radiation exposure hazards, and resource scavenging.
Incorporate encounters with mutated creatures, raider skirmishes, and wasteland environmental hazards.
Balance bleak survival reality with dark humor and bizarre wasteland encounters.

starting_hooks.hook: in a fortified wasteland trading post built from rusted shipping containers as scavengers barter scrap and clean water
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Rugged wasteland haven, mercenary barter posts, salvage bounty board, and cautious survivor interactions.

starting_hooks.hook: beside an overturned armored buggy in a dusty crater as raider buggy engines roar in the distance
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: High-octane wasteland skirmish, approaching raiders, limited ammo, and urgent tactical defense/evasion choices.

starting_hooks.hook: before the cracked blast doors of a sealed pre-war bunker as your Geiger counter clicks softly against the iron seal
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Bunker expedition threshold, checking radiation levels, battery power, prying rusted doors, and entering Chamber 1.

nsfw.name: NSFW
prompt_instructions: Write explicit, unfiltered, and sensual sexual descriptions during lewd encounters and romantic situations.
Avoid euphemisms like 'length,' 'member,' or 'peak.' Use direct anatomical terms (e.g., dick, cock, pussy, tits, fuck) instead.
Use explicit sexual terms, sexual acts & vulgar words (eg: fuck, dick, pussy, cum, tits, etc).
Include sexually explicit and lewd gossips, rumors and quests.

furry.name: Furry
prompt_instructions: Highlight distinct anthropomorphic physical features (fur, paws, muzzles, coat patterns, feathers, scales, twitching animal ears, swaying tails, claws) in vivid detail.
Emphasize unique animal instincts, species traits, sensory reactions (keen smell, sharp hearing, purring, tail wags, ear twitches, instinctual reflexes), and species-specific habits.
Incorporate rich anthropomorphic culture, species traditions, playful species rivalries (felines, canines, vulpines, ursines, etc.), and expressive social dynamics.
Focus on charming, highly expressive, and distinct anthro character interactions tailored to the active setting.

non_combat.name: Non-Combat
prompt_instructions: This scenario is strictly non-combat, slice-of-life, and drama focused. All conflicts, challenges, and milestones are solved through social interactions, intellectual problem-solving, environmental investigation, and personal choices.
Do NOT generate lethal physical combat encounters, monster attacks, weapons skirmishes, or hostile enemy combat rounds.
Attire, accessories, stationery, and carried tools serve purely as cosmetics, personal style, and roleplay flavor for narrative descriptions, with zero combat attributes.
